text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's exploits at the Fantasy
Stakes have a direct effect on her
popularity at the
Hanshin Juvenile
Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan, you have a massive lead
in the
popularity polls. Some are already
saying you're
the star of the show!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's right. The star of the show today
really is
Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else has one job to do, and
that's to
commit the name "Aston
Machan" to memory.
Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow! So you're declaring that you'll
be taking
first place today?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Of course I am.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her bold statement triggers a storm of
camera
flashes. Then, someone joins her.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hold it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm here too, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All eyes in the room jump to the
Umamusume
crashing the interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
That's the girl who just barely squeezed
onto the
poll, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: What was her name again... Ah! Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You can shove that crap about me
"barely"
making it! Who even cares?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You think Aston Machan is the star just
'cause
she's leadin' the polls? Hah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Maybe you lot don't know it yet, but me... I'm the strongest Umamusume that's ever lived!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't believe me? Just watch me today!
I'll show
ya the coolest thing you've ever
seen!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Your guys' actual job today is to watch
the
ascension of the great Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Cause I'm the one who's gonna win this thing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flash! Flash! Flash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Vodka turns on her heels and

disappears toward the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...
There she goes. That idiot...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
News of her fiery declaration quickly
makes the
rounds, and it's not long
before word reaches the
stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear? Vodka challenged
Aston
Machan right to her face!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It just happened, right? What was
it she
said? "The ascension of the great
Vodka"?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She must really be planning to bring it!
Sounds
like she might be worth keeping
an eye on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, Vodka begins to garner some
attention
of her own.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh! Grrr! Stop! Stop, damn you!

...There! Finally!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Nope. You're still shaking.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Am not.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Are too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No, I'm not!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Look at you! Shaking like a leaf after
making a
big scene like that! That's so
lame!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Quit callin' me lame! It's not like I'm
tremblin'
'cause I want to!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I mean, I'm not even tremblin' in the
first place!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...If I were in the audience, I'd think a
racer
coming out of the blue and
winning it all was the
coolest thing ever.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'd want to watch her next race. And I'd
be
looking forward to seeing how she
does in her
classic year.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Is there a better setup than a totally
unknown
underdog going for the win?
It's the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The coolest, huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You're right.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I already talked the talk, now I've just gotta walk the walk and deliver! Now that's cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Just you watch, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes. Go ahead and show me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...The things I put up with for her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Now that's a friend.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...But it is what it is. Today,
Vodka's just
going to
have to look lame.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I put loveliness aside on the racetrack.
